name: Tulsa
summary: An oil-boom Art Deco city on Route 66 — a spectacular new riverfront park, a villa art museum, and the Greenwood district's hard, essential history.

lodging.name: A downtown Tulsa hotel
lodging.blurb: Near the Deco district and the Gathering Place.

foodMustTry.name: An Oklahoma onion burger
foodMustTry.blurb: Griddled with smashed onions — a state classic.

days.label: Day 316 — Deco, Greenwood & the Gathering Place
days.summary: Oil wealth, hard history, and a world-class park.

item.title: Greenwood Rising & Black Wall Street
item.blurb: The history center for the once-thriving Black Wall Street and the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre — sobering and important.

item.title: The Gathering Place & Philbrook

location.name: Gathering Place
location.address: 2650 S John Williams Way, Tulsa, OK

item.blurb: A lavish, award-winning riverfront park, plus the Philbrook Museum in an Italian-villa mansion.

commute.scenicNote: Southwest on the turnpike to Oklahoma City.
